title: Native Ringed Restriction Slices
statement: A dense equivalence of sites induces a dense equivalence on every slice. Direct module restriction commutes with over-site restriction, and both global and slice module restrictions are equivalences. With the displayed additive sheafification and derived-category structures, the square formed by their exact derived functors commutes by a natural isomorphism, with independent site and coefficient sizes. Dependencies: [lem-pur-native-ringed-restriction-equivalence], [lem-sf-site-perfect-restriction-exact], [lem-sf-site-perfect-restriction-additive], [lem-sf-site-perfect-derived-restriction-iso], [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image].

proof.text: The exact derived restriction square commutes. Both module restrictions are additive equivalences; the two over-functors are exact. Descend their identity square to derived categories and compose the two derived-composition comparison isomorphisms. Source: Stacks 03A0, 03CH, 03DA, 03DG and 08J7.
